changes: p3 name: 'Mādhavaśarman' changed to 'Mādhava'; śarman kept only as a title
p2/p3 residence: cleared. Nāhoṃsagrāma is only where the copy was made, not a stated residence
notes added: śarman could apply to both names in the compound; LS epoch uncertain

notes: Two scribes are named in one dual compound, 'śrīpadmakaraśrīmādhavaśarmmabhyāṃ'. The suffix -śarman may belong to both, which would make Padmakara a śarman too, but it is attached only to Mādhava here. ce_approx uses LS+1119. The epoch of the Lakṣmaṇa Saṃvat is disputed, so the CE year may be off by a few years. Nāhoṃsagrāma (probably in Mithilā) is not identified. The verse after the colophon (triṃśadaṅgulam...) and a later addition in another hand are not part of the scribal colophon.
